test_title: PYST 14: SSC JE EE- General Awareness (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Morning Shift)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following schemes was initiated with the intention of creating a level-playing field for meritorious Indian girls from grades 9 to 12 to pursue Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) in their higher education?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vigyan Jyoti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vigyan Jyoti** was introduced by **The Department of Science & Technology (DST)** in the year **2019**.
 
• The program is for women and was initiated to inspire women to **pursue careers in STEM**
 
• This Program address the issue of the u**nderrepresentation of women in the field of STEM**.
 
• The program **envisions** creating a **level-playing field** for **meritorious girls** in high school to pursue **Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM)** in their **higher education**
 
• The program also offers **exposure** to the meritorious **girls from rural backgrounds** to help to pursue their journey from **school to a job** in the **field of** **Science**.
 
• The program plans for interventions to motivate girls right from class IX i.e. **school level **and it will continue to guide them till** Ph.D.** to encourage careers in** underrepresented areas of STEM **by women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Various activities** are being **conducted** in the program in order to **motivate girls**

 
 
• **Science camps, **
 
• **Special lectures/ classes **from eminent **women scientists****, **
 
• Counseling of **students** and **parents, **
 
• **Interaction** with **role models, **
 
• **Tinkering activities, **
 
• Visit **Knowledge Partners/ Research Labs/ Industries/ NGOs.**
 
 
 
• **Vigyan Jyoti** is implemented by **The Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) **which is an organization of the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD).
 
• The **2ⁿd phase** of the **Vigyan Jyoti** program was launched on **11th February 2021** on the occasion of the **International Day of Women and Girls in Science**.
 
• From the **1st phase **of the Vigyan Jyoti Program **50 Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNV) **were acting as **Vigyan Jyoti Knowledge Centres **since December** 2019**
 
• The **2ⁿd phase** added more **50 JNVs** to the existing **50 JNVs** making it a total of **100** **Vigyan Jyoti Knowledge Centres**.
 
• The program **Vigyan Jyoti** aims to tap **100 girl students** in **550 districts** from** 2020-2025**.
